name: Itsumi
source:
Koji’s childhood friend that moved away after middle school. She always really liked Koji, and wished that she could be with him again. By chance, the two end up meeting in the shopping district, and Koji doesn’t recognize the now much more mature girl. She is typically very blunt, and even more shameless when it comes to her job at the cafe.

Will Koji finally realize his feelings for his best friend from middle school, or will he crack under the pressure of working in the fast-paced food business?
